@everyone — charity stream for the linden community pantry: sat nov 21, 10am to 10pm

last year we raised $212 and like half the server didn't even know it was happening because i posted it the thursday before. so we're posting early this time and i actually need people to show up.

goal is $600. rook is matching the first $100, so the first hundred counts double. donate at lindenpantry.example/mrkz — it goes straight to the pantry, they don't take anything off the top. every $1 gets them about 4 lbs of food through their wholesale partner, and they're serving around 340 families a week right now. shelves are the lowest they've been going into thanksgiving.

it's not begging if you get hair dye content out of it lol. incentives:
$100 = i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 = chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON stream
$400 = 1 hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 = i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry arranges

even $3 helps. if $3 is all you can do that's genuinely fine and i'm not gonna make you feel bad about it. can't donate at all? show up, hang in chat, that helps too.

no card? you're still good — drop off canned or boxed food in the blue bin by their side door saturdays 9 to 1, or just be there.

game plan: first half community lobbies (i'll drop the code, anyone can join), second half chat votes on a new game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps larry i promise.

nov 21. let's actually hit 600 this time.
